name: Vietnam Hosting — Ubuntu 20.04 Legacy (NAT Linux Container)
description: Unprivileged Ubuntu 20.04 Legacy NAT Linux container compatible with Pterodactyl Console, Wings SFTP, user-space SSH (pubkey-only), persistent storage, and container-safe task scheduling. Not a KVM VPS (no root/systemd/privileged mode). Standard support ended May 2025 (ESM only). Migrate to Ubuntu 24.04 or 26.04 LTS for new workloads.

privileged_requirements.notes: Runs completely unprivileged inside standard Pterodactyl Wings isolation.
